title: Logged steps on a broad set of links, with the arrival and flow-count labels
description: The step data the codec is trained on (experiments/phase0-steps.json), generated again in compact so that each step also carries the three ground-truth labels grounding needs and the first copy lacks: label_arrival_rate_bps, label_flow_arrival_rate_bps and label_active_flows (src/expliccit_env/labels.py). Same campaign: 2,400 links, two conditions each from a broad set of 64, three controllers per link, 30 s episodes, every 6th 10 ms step kept (examples/net1_broad.py, set train30), 20 shards. Episodes run in virtual time from seeds, so the observations and actions should equal the first copy's; the log entry citing this release says whether they do. The rule controller comes from experiments/steps-behaviour-rule.json.
prepare: uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-train30" --set train30 --models "$IN/rule/models" && uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-train30/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-train30"
run: uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-train30" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6
collect: uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-train30" > "$OUT/status-train30.json"; { echo '| set | status |'; echo '|---|---|'; echo "| train30 | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-train30.json") |"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
